candidates.name: OpenUp
candidates.one_liner: An Amsterdam-based employee mental wellbeing platform offering direct, preventive support for organizations and their teams.
why_ankit_fits: OpenUp sits at the intersection of workplace wellbeing, behavior change, product experience, and organizational systems.
Ankit can connect mental wellbeing propositions with AI-enabled personalization, manager enablement, and measurable workplace outcomes.
problems_to_solve: Turn wellbeing from a reactive benefit into a proactive employee growth and resilience system.
Design product journeys that help HR, managers, and employees act on insights without compromising trust or privacy.

candidates.name: Amaha
candidates.one_liner: An Indian mental healthcare ecosystem providing therapy, psychiatry, self-care, and employee wellbeing programs.
why_ankit_fits: Amaha combines clinical mental healthcare, workplace wellbeing, digital self-care, and education-oriented support journeys.
Ankit can help translate its ecosystem into clearer product pathways for employees, families, institutions, and employers.
problems_to_solve: Make preventive mental wellbeing feel accessible before people reach crisis points.
Use product strategy and responsible AI workflows to improve personalization, engagement, and employer insights while preserving empathy and safety.

candidates.name: Kyan Health
candidates.one_liner: A Zurich-based workplace mental health and wellbeing platform combining human care, AI navigation, and organizational insights.
why_ankit_fits: Kyan Health frames employee wellbeing as a system-level workplace capability rather than a disconnected benefit.
Ankit can bridge AI workflows, product strategy, privacy-sensitive insights, and human-centered behavior change for enterprise teams.
problems_to_solve: Help organizations move from reactive EAP usage to preventive, measurable wellbeing systems.
Explore trustworthy AI-supported navigation and aggregated insights that improve care access without weakening employee confidentiality.
